title: Can Rabbits Eat Peppers?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Peppers?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage, bedding guide and hay guide.
- Replace the image URLs below with your pepper images once uploaded.
-->

<section class="rcp-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-peppers">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcp-page,
    .rcp-page * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main {
      background: #fef4f0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image {
      display: none !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * {
      margin-block-start: 0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcp-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcp-page a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .rcp-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcp-wrap {
      width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rcp-narrow {
      width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rcp-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcp-pill::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
    }

    .rcp-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcp-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcp-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .rcp-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcp-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcp-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcp-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcp-hero-cover {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rcp-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcp-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcpFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcp-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcp-hero-title-overlay .rcp-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcp-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcp-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcp-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcp-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcp-breadcrumb a {
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
    }

    .rcp-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcp-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcp-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcp-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcp-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcp-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcp-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcp-quickbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 4;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .rcp-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcp-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcp-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcp-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcp-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcp-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcp-section {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .rcp-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcp-section h2,
    .rcp-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcp-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcp-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcp-content {
      display: grid;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .rcp-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcp-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcp-panel > * {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .rcp-panel h2 {
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rcp-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcp-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcp-panel p:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .rcp-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcp-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcp-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcp-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcp-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcp-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcp-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rcp-treat-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.22rem;
    }

    .rcp-treat-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcp-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcp-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcp-warning-card h2 {
      color: var(--rc-danger);
    }

    .rcp-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcp-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcp-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcp-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcp-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcp-image-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 430px;
    }

    .rcp-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rcp-image-card img:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important;
    }

    .rcp-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcp-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rcp-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcp-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcp-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcp-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcp-step h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.16rem;
    }

    .rcp-step p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcp-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcp-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcp-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcp-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcp-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcp-side-card a:hover {
      transform: translateX(4px);
      background: #fff4d8;
    }

    .rcp-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcp-note strong {
      color: var(--rc-moss);
    }

    .rcp-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcp-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcp-benefit h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcp-benefit p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcp-final {
      padding: 70px 0 42px;
      background: #fef4f0;
    }

    .rcp-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-tomato-3.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcp-final-box .rcp-pill,
    .rcp-final-box h2,
    .rcp-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcp-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcp-final-box .rcp-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rcp-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rcp-related,
    .rcp-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcp-related .rcp-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rcp-related .rcp-section-header .rcp-pill {
      color: #4e6b45 !important;
    }

    .rcp-related .rcp-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcp-related .rcp-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;

    <section class="rcp-section rcp-prep rcp-reveal" id="prepare">
      <div class="rcp-wrap">
        <div class="rcp-section-header">
          <span class="rcp-pill">Simple preparation</span>
          <h2>How to prepare peppers for rabbits</h2>
          <p>
            Before feeding bell pepper to your rabbit, prepare it carefully and keep it plain, raw and free from seasoning.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcp-steps">
          <article class="rcp-step">
            <b>1</b>
            <h3>Choose sweet bell pepper</h3>
            <p>Use red, yellow, orange or green bell pepper. Do not use chilli or hot pepper.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcp-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Wash thoroughly</h3>
            <p>Rinse the pepper well to remove dirt or residue from the skin.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcp-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Remove seeds and stem</h3>
            <p>Cut away the stalk, seeds and white inner pith before offering a piece.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcp-step">
            <b>4</b>
            <h3>Cut a small strip</h3>
            <p>Offer a small raw strip and watch your rabbit’s digestion afterwards.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcp-section rcp-reveal" id="benefits">
      <div class="rcp-wrap">
        <div class="rcp-section-header">
          <span class="rcp-pill">Fresh food benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys peppers</h2>
          <p>
            When given in moderation, bell pepper can be a colourful addition to your rabbit’s fresh food selection. Even if your rabbit enjoys it, hay should remain the main part of the diet.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcp-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rcp-benefit">
            <h3>Adds variety</h3>
            <p>A small strip of bell pepper can add colour and variety to a hay-based diet.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcp-benefit">
            <h3>Crunchy texture</h3>
            <p>Some rabbits enjoy the crisp texture, which can make fresh food time more interesting.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcp-benefit">
            <h3>Small amounts of nutrients</h3>
            <p>Bell peppers contain vitamins and plant nutrients, but they should not replace leafy greens or hay.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcp-benefit">
            <h3>Good for enrichment</h3>
            <p>Small pepper strips can be scattered with greens to encourage gentle foraging.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcp-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may run over, sniff eagerly, nibble quickly or search for another small piece.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcp-benefit">
            <h3>Still introduce slowly</h3>
            <p>Even safe foods should be introduced gradually so your rabbit’s digestion can adjust.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rcp-section rcp-faq rcp-reveal" id="faqs">
      <div class="rcp-narrow">
        <div class="rcp-section-header">
          <span class="rcp-pill">Peppers FAQs</span>
          <h2>FAQs about rabbits and peppers</h2>
          <p>
            Quick answers to common questions about feeding bell peppers to rabbits safely.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcp-faq-list">
          <details class="rcp-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat peppers?</summary>
            <p>Yes, rabbits can eat sweet bell peppers in small amounts. Red, yellow, orange and green bell peppers can all be offered occasionally, but they should be introduced slowly and served plain and raw.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcp-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat bell peppers?</summary>
            <p>Yes, bell peppers are the safe type of pepper for rabbits. They can add colour and crunch to a varied diet, but they should not replace hay or leafy greens.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcp-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat red, yellow, orange and green peppers?</summary>
            <p>Yes, rabbits can eat red, yellow, orange and green sweet bell peppers. Red, yellow and orange peppers are usually sweeter, while green peppers can taste more bitter, so your rabbit may prefer one colour over another.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcp-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat chilli peppers or spicy peppers?</summary>
            <p>No. Rabbits should not eat chilli peppers, jalapeños, hot peppers or any spicy pepper varieties. Spicy peppers can irritate a rabbit's mouth and digestive system.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcp-faq-item">
            <summary>Do you need to remove pepper seeds for rabbits?</summary>
            <p>Yes, it is best to remove the stem, seeds and white inner pith before feeding bell pepper. Offer only a small strip of the plain raw pepper flesh.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcp-faq-item">
            <summary>How much pepper can rabbits eat?</summary>
            <p>A sensible amount is one or two small strips of sweet bell pepper, introduced slowly as part of a varied diet. Start with a tiny piece and monitor your rabbit's droppings, appetite and behaviour.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcp-final rcp-reveal">
      <div class="rcp-wrap rcp-final-box">
        <span class="rcp-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Bell peppers can be a safe fresh food for rabbits</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat small amounts of sweet bell pepper, including red, yellow, orange and green varieties. Bell pepper can add colour and crunch, but it should be introduced slowly and served in small portions.
        </p>
        <p>
          Never feed chilli peppers, spicy peppers, cooked peppers, pickled peppers or seasoned peppers. A rabbit’s diet should still be based mainly on hay, with fresh vegetables and leafy greens forming the rest of their daily food.
        </p>
